newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.017pts to 103.032.
newsitem.headline: Czech BICS100 bond index rises 0.017pts to 103.032.

text.p: The BICS 100 index measuring the Czech Republic's most liquid bonds rose 0.017 points in Thursday's trading to 103.032, bank Ceska Sporitelna said.
It said the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.083 years.

The BICSG 100 index, which Ceska Sporitelna calculates using only government bonds, rose 0.030 points to 99.401, the bank said, and the duration of the index portfolio shortened by 0.003 points to 2.190 years.
It said the yield index YBICS 1000 fell 1.082 points to 1,041.313.
